question: To which goddess is the festival of Navratri dedicated to?
solution: The correct answer is __**Durga**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Navratri** is a Hindu festival dedicated to **Goddess Durga**, who represents power, strength, and protection. • The word **Navratri** translates to "nine nights," during which nine forms of Goddess Durga are worshipped, each symbolising distinct attributes such as courage, knowledge, and devotion. • Goddess Durga is often depicted as slaying the demon **Mahishasura**, symbolising the victory of good over evil. • Navratri is celebrated twice a year: **Chaitra Navratri** (March-April) and **Sharad Navratri** (September-October), with Sharad Navratri being the most prominent. • Devotees observe rituals such as fasting, chanting mantras, and performing **Garba** and **Dandiya Raas** dances in honor of Goddess Durga during Navratri.
